clue.text: Possibly uppermost in arrogance

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters of the following words might be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Arrogance is perhaps the quality most to the fore in someone's character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' tells you to rearrange UPPERMOST IN; the eleven letters match exactly.
explanation.definitionFit: Presumption is overconfident boldness, a close synonym for arrogance.

clue.text: Stuff with hair — it's for reasons of safety

parts.note: to pad is to stuff with soft material
a lock is a tress of hair

explanation.surface: Stuffing something with hair for protective reasons.
explanation.definitionFit: A padlock is a detachable lock used to keep things secure, a safety device.

clue.text: Supporter of general uprising when accepted

indicators.note: accepted means the turned name takes the little word inside it
in a down clue uprising means the name is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: Backing a general revolt when it is accepted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprising' turns LEE into EEL, which accepts AS.
explanation.definitionFit: An easel is a stand that holds up a painting or board, a supporter.

clue.text: Organisation has means of raising car standard

parts.note: a union is an organisation such as a trade union
a jack lifts a car to change a tyre

explanation.surface: A motoring body owns a car jack of standard type.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standard' is a flag here, not a norm; the UNION JACK is the UK national flag.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a flag or banner, and this is the national flag of the UK.

clue.text: Regularly praises successful result of exam taker

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Someone often praises a student's exam success.
explanation.definitionFit: A pass is the outcome when a candidate succeeds in an examination.

clue.text: One student's floor-covering is in a state

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
L, a learner driver's plate, stands for a student
lino is linoleum, a floor covering

explanation.surface: One student's carpet is in a terrible condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a state' suggests a mess; here 'state' is a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Illinois is one of the states of the USA.

clue.text: I complain when she comes up

indicators.note: in a down clue coming up means the whole phrase is read upwards

parts.note: to moan is to complain

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles whenever a certain woman appears.
explanation.definitionFit: Naomi is a woman's name, so a she, as in the biblical Naomi.

clue.text: Anticipate report of third-stream class

indicators.note: report of means the words are as heard spoken rather than as spelt

parts.note: schools stream year groups as A, B, C, so 4C is a class in the third stream

explanation.surface: Predicting the school report of a lower-set class.
explanation.walkthrough: The heard form is 'four C', a school class name.
explanation.definitionFit: To foresee is to see in advance, to anticipate.

clue.text: A leading Catholic clergyman is precise

indicators.note: leading means the first letter of the following word

parts.note: a curate is an assistant parish priest

explanation.surface: A senior Catholic priest is exact in his ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Accurate means correct in every detail, a synonym of precise.

clue.text: Notice girl being embraced by two others

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, short for Diana

indicators.note: being embraced by means the girl's word is held inside the other two names

parts.note: Sal is a girl's name, short for Sally
a miss is a girl or young unmarried woman

explanation.surface: A girl is wrapped in a hug by two other girls and receives a notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two others' supplies two more girls' names, one either side of the third girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Being given notice at work means being sacked, so notice is a synonym for dismissal.

clue.text: In three-quarters of an hour two hundred take place

indicators.note: In places the following number inside the shortened word for a period of time
three-quarters of a four-letter word keeps three of its letters, here the final three

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so CC is two hundred

explanation.surface: Something happening two hundred times within forty-five minutes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'three-quarters of an hour' reads like 45 minutes, but it means three of the four letters of HOUR: OUR, with CC put in.
explanation.definitionFit: To occur is to happen, a direct synonym for take place.

clue.text: Small number return to job connected with computers

indicators.note: return means the abbreviation is turned round to read backwards

parts.note: No. is the short form of number
a line, as in 'line of work', is an occupation

explanation.surface: A handful of people going back to their work, which involves computers.
explanation.definitionFit: Online describes activity done through networked computers, connected to the internet.

clue.text: Involved in a quest for relics of a bygone age

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled up together into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A treasure hunter takes part in a search for ancient objects.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Involved in' looks like a phrase, but 'in' is part of the fodder: IN A QUEST rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Antiques are old collectable objects, things surviving from a past era.

clue.text: Gear-case?

parts.note: read not as a mechanical housing but as a container for a soldier's or traveller's gear

explanation.definitionFit: A kitbag is a bag holding one's kit, that is one's equipment or gear.

clue.text: Box smart during trial

indicators.note: during means the pain word sits inside the trial word

parts.note: a test is a trial
to smart is to sting or ache

explanation.surface: A boxer feels pain partway through a contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smart' looks like an adjective but is the verb, to hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea chest is a wooden box used for shipping tea, and later for moving house.

clue.text: Lose, to put it badly

definitions.meaning: to lose an item is to mislay it
to put something in the wrong place, mis- meaning badly

explanation.definitionFit: Mislaying something is losing it by setting it down in the wrong spot.

clue.text: Explain how to record one's vote

definitions.meaning: to put something across is to communicate or explain it
on a ballot paper you ... by your choice

explanation.definitionFit: Put across means convey clearly; read as 'put a cross' it is marking a ballot.

clue.text: No cup-tie may be postponed

indicators.note: may be indicates the letters could become something else

explanation.surface: A cup match may be delayed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' tells you to rearrange NO CUPTIE.
explanation.definitionFit: Put on ice is an idiom for deferred or postponed.

clue.text: Need to have match around for when it's dark

indicators.note: around means the contest's word is placed on both sides of the want

parts.note: a bout is a fight or contest, a match
lack means want or need

explanation.surface: Someone needs to strike a match to see in the dark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'match' suggests something to strike for light; it is a boxing-style contest, BOUT.
explanation.definitionFit: A blackout is a period of darkness, such as a power failure or wartime light restriction.

clue.text: Commercial interrupts fight — it's a boring item

indicators.note: interrupts means the advert breaks into the fight word

parts.note: a brawl is a rough fight
an ad is a commercial

explanation.surface: An advert break cuts into a televised fight, which is dull.
explanation.definitionFit: A bradawl is a small pointed tool for boring holes in wood.

clue.text: Be there at the beginning and finale

indicators.note: the beginning of the word the is its first letter

parts.note: a finale is the end

explanation.surface: Advice to be present at both the opening and the close of an event.
explanation.definitionFit: To attend is to be present at an event, being there.

clue.text: Underwear designers?

definitions.meaning: people who draw, as designers do

explanation.definitionFit: Drawers are underpants, and also people who draw, such as designers.

clue.text: So he and I form a strong attachment

indicators.note: form means the following letters are made into a new shape

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Two people declaring that together they make a close bond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'form' tells you to rearrange SO HE AND I.
explanation.definitionFit: Adhesion is the act of sticking firmly to something, a strong attachment.

clue.text: Shelter in street from snow and rain

indicators.note: in means the shelter word is put inside the street abbreviation

parts.note: lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind

explanation.surface: Taking cover in a street to escape the wintry weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleet is a mixture of snow and rain, or partly melted snow falling.

clue.text: Two bills I stuck on a tree

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
a second AC, another account
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone pins two invoices and a note to a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The acacia is a tree or shrub, often thorny, of warm regions.

clue.text: Infant learner told off, put outside

indicators.note: put outside means the scolding word goes around the learner

parts.note: chid is an old past tense of chide, to tell off
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A small pupil is scolded and sent out of the room.
explanation.definitionFit: An infant is a young child.

clue.text: Incentive to knock time off sprint

indicators.note: to knock something off is to remove it
off completes the instruction to take a letter away

parts.note: a spurt is a short sprint

explanation.surface: Motivation to cut seconds off a race time.
explanation.definitionFit: A spur is a goad, something that urges on, hence an incentive.

clue.text: Passage from a small island

parts.note: an isle is a small island

explanation.surface: A sea crossing from a little island.
explanation.definitionFit: An aisle is a walkway between rows of seats, a passage.

clue.text: Is in better position to be inventive

indicators.note: in means the short word is placed inside the longer one

parts.note: to improve one's position is to better it
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone with an advantage is free to be creative.
explanation.definitionFit: To improvise is to invent or make something up on the spot, being inventive.

clue.text: Struggles to maintain faith in the past

definitions.text: Struggles to maintain faith in the past

parts.words: Struggles to maintain faith in the past
parts.note: describes medieval holy wars, fought in the name of defending and spreading a religion

explanation.definitionFit: The medieval Christian military campaigns were waged supposedly to defend the faith in the Holy Land.
